calibration_sources: MInference 1.0: Accelerating Pre-filling for Long-Context LLMs via Dynamic Sparse Attention (A-Shape, Vertical-Slash, Block-Sparse)
Quest: Query-Aware Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference (Min-Max Page Envelope Bounding Box Scoring)
LLMLingua-2 & H2O / SnapKV Permanent KV Eviction Failure Modes under Multi-Turn Topic Shifts

workload_baseline.session_profile: 128,000-token context × 5 sequential multi-turn questions shifting focus across the document

tiers.name: Tier 1: Full 128K Dense FlashAttention-3 Prefill + Full 128K Paged KV Decode (100% Compute & HBM Read)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 全量 128K 稠密 Prefill + 全量 128K KV 逐词读取 Decode (O(N^2) 算力墙 + 显存带宽墙)
tiers.mechanism: Computes all 128K×128K causal attention pairs during prefill and reads all 41.9 GB of 128K KV cache on every decode step

tiers.name: Tier 2: Hard Input Token Pruning (LLMLingua-2 4x Text Compression Before LLM + Prefix Cache Breakage)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 输入端硬删词压缩 (LLMLingua-2 4x 删词：破坏代码/数字语法且无法跨多轮保护未知考点)
tiers.mechanism: BERT/XLM-R token classifier drops 75% of input tokens (128K -> 32K) before LLM prefill; irreversibly deletes exact numbers/code syntax

tiers.name: Tier 3: Permanent KV Cache Eviction (H2O / SnapKV Drops 85% of KV After Turn-1 Query)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 永久性 KV 驱逐 (H2O / SnapKV 按第 1 问注意力永久删掉 85% KV：第 2~5 问换话题即失忆)
tiers.mechanism: Evicts 85% of KV blocks permanently based on Turn-1 prompt attention; Turn-2..5 questions targeting previously evicted sections fail

tiers.name: Tier 4: MInference Vertical-Slash Sparse Prefill + Quest Non-Destructive Page-Envelope Top-4K KV Selection
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 预填充 MInference 垂直-斜线动态稀疏 + 解码期 Quest 页面包络非破坏性检索 (保留全量 KV 但每步仅读 Top-4K)
tiers.mechanism: MInference skips 88% of 128K^2 prefill tiles via per-head Vertical-Slash patterns; Quest retains 100% KV in HBM/DRAM but scores [K_min, K_max] page bounding boxes to load only Top-4,096 KV tokens per decode step

context_perturbation.insight: MInference speeds up 32K prefill 3.45x; Quest non-destructive Top-4K selection preserves Turn-2..5 recall
Quadratic O(N^2) attention begins dominating 64K prefill; MInference reaches 5.18x speedup

context_perturbation.condition: 128K Context (5-Turn Legal / Repo Deep Dive Baseline)
context_perturbation.insight: 8.13x faster TTFT (14.80s -> 1.82s) and 4.74x faster TPOT (46.5ms -> 9.8ms) with 98.9% multi-turn recall
10.95x faster prefill TTFT; permanent KV eviction (Tier 3) loses half of multi-turn needles at 256K
